{{Short description|American psychologist}}
'''David Budescu''' ({{Langx|he|דוד בודסקו}}) is a [[psychologist]] and [[Academic staff|academic]]. He is the Anne Anastasi Professor of Psychometrics and Quantitative Psychology at [[Fordham University]].

==Personal life==

Budescu graduated from the [[University of Haifa]] in [[Haifa]], Israel and received his [[Ph.D.]] in [[quantitative psychology]] from the [[University of North Carolina]] in 1980.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.psych.uiuc.edu/~dbudescu/education.html |title=David V. Budescu, Education |access-date=2009-02-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090624013102/http://www.psych.uiuc.edu/~dbudescu/education.html |archive-date=2009-06-24 |url-status=dead }}</ref> From 1982 to 1992 he taught at the [[University of Haifa]] and, in 1992, accepted an appointment at the [[University of Illinois]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cambridge.org/us/catalogue/catalogue.asp?isbn=9780521808927&ss=fro|title=Contemporary Psychological Research on Social Dilemmas - Cambridge University Press|website=www.cambridge.org}}</ref> He is a fellow of the [[American Psychological Society]] and is a past director of the [[European Association of Decision Making]]. In 2016 he won the [[Exeter Prize]] for the best paper published in the fields of [[experimental economics]], [[decision theory]], and [[behavioural economics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://business-school.exeter.ac.uk/research/exeter_prize/#:~:text=The%20winners%20of%20the%20Exeter,%2C%202015%2C%20267%2D280.|title=University of Exeter Business School: Exeter Prize}}</ref>  In 1999 he edited "Games and Human Behavior: Essays in Honor of Amnon Rapoport."

==Current work==

Budescu researches the effects of uncertainty in human decision-making as well as psychometrics.<ref>{{cite web|author=Fordham |url=https://www.fordham.edu/info/21660/psychology_faculty_and_staff/5294/david_budescu |title=Fordham Homepage |publisher=Fordham University: David V. Budescu |date= |accessdate=2021-06-03}}</ref> He has also done work on group decision-making and markets.<ref name="auto">{{cite web|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=f8zVLj8AAAAJ&hl=en|title=Google Scholar David Budescu| accessdate=1 May 2022}}</ref> Budescu is currently the editor of the [[American Psychological Association]] journal Decision.<ref>{{cite web|author=APA |url=https://www.apa.org/pubs/journals/dec |title=Decision |publisher=APA |date= |accessdate=2021-06-03}}</ref> He also sits on the editorial board of the [[Journal of Behavioral Decision Making]]. In 2009 he was appointed Anne Anastasi Professor of Psychometrics and Quantitative Psychology at [[Fordham University]].<ref>{{cite web|author=Fordham |url=http://www.fordham.edu/campus_resources/enewsroom/inside_fordham/january_20_2009/news/psychology_scholar_i_33195.asp |title=Fordham Homepage |publisher=Fordham.edu |date= |accessdate=2020-04-22}}</ref> His regular collaborators include [[Amnon Rapoport]], [[Boris Maciejovsky]], and [[Dan Ariely]].
